objective: Launch Rangeen Cosmetics' new deep-berry shade with a story-format packshot whose shade matches the supplied pack, and a silent six-second version of the same accepted still.
hard_constraints: the shade matches the supplied packshot — 'shade bilkul match hona chahiye, warna returns aate hain'
no person, model or hand appears — 'koi model ya haath nahi'
the lettering does not move in the moving version — 'Text hilna nahi chahiye'
the moving version is silent — 'bina awaaz ke'
acceptance_statements: ACCEPT only if exactly one lipstick bullet in a matte black case is in frame and no person, hand or second product appears.
ACCEPT only if the lipstick's shade matches the supplied packshot when the two are shown side by side.
REJECT if the case, cap or bullet is deformed, doubled or cut off by the frame edge.

composition.attention_order: 1st read: the bullet, by contrast against a dark ground. 2nd read: the headline, by size. 3rd read: the brand line.
composition.placement_zone: pack in the middle zone, slightly off-centre; headline in the upper zone; brand line in the lower band
composition.edge_treatment: tight fit with a deliberate margin; the pack never touches a frame edge
composition.motion_note: the moving version holds the frame edges fixed; only a slow light drift across the case moves

materials_and_light.surface_finish_per_key_object: case: matte black, one declared soft highlight and no mirror specular; bullet: satin cream-to-berry, one highlight; ground: matte charcoal
materials_and_light.implied_light_source: one large soft source above and slightly left; every highlight and shadow agrees with it, and the highlight reads as large and soft rather than as a point
materials_and_light.separation: the matte black case separates from the charcoal ground by a rim of the soft source, not by a second light
